entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Ugh, finally. Just get me a person already!
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return this helmet. It's useless. Send me a shipping label right now. I don't have time for this.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
Are you deaf? The issue is I don't want it! The color is absolutely not what it looked like online. It’s hideous. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. Just process the return!
I understand. I'm happy to help with that. I just need to pull up your order information. Can I get your order number or email address?
This is ridiculous. It's customer@example.com. If this isn't resolved in two minutes, I'm posting a review about this experience everywhere. Maybe I should just talk to your manager instead.
I can definitely handle this for you, there's no need to escalate. One moment while I pull up your details... Okay, I see your order for the Aero-Lite Helmet, delivered 48 days ago.
I've just checked our policy. You are well within the 90-day return window. I'm generating a return label for you as we speak. I have just sent it to the email on file.
Wait, really? That's it? It's a full refund, right? No games?

Yes, a full refund to your original payment method once we receive the item. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, and your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. There will be no issues.
Huh. Okay. Fine. Just make sure that email comes through.
It has already been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
